story.title: Built on the Water. Built for Qatar.
story.lead: Born at the heart of Qatar's coastline, Rigoo Marine was founded by master technicians who understood one thing above all else — the sea demands excellence, not excuses.
story.highlight: From a precision engine workshop, we've grown into Qatar's most trusted full-service marine facility. Whether it's a routine check-up, a structural overhaul, or a 2 a.m. emergency call — we show up, fully equipped and fully committed.
story.close: Transparent QAR pricing. Bilingual service. A team that treats every vessel as their own. That's not just our process — that's our promise.
